specification.no: No service satisfying every YES criterion launched before the cutoff. Cambridge, Somerville or other Greater Boston service alone does not qualify. A later launch is NO for this deadline.
specification.resolution_source: Prefer dated Waymo or operating-partner launch announcements, service maps, fare/access terms, and relevant state/city permits; corroborate actual public passenger operations with reputable contemporaneous reporting. Later evidence can establish an earlier launch, but a later launch cannot satisfy the cutoff.
specification.text: Will paid, publicly accessible driverless Waymo service launch within Boston before January 1, 2029?
specification.void: Only if the recorded criteria cannot be interpreted or verified because the question is materially defective; corporate withdrawal, prohibition, delay, or failure to launch is NO, not void. Use disputed while genuine evidentiary disagreement remains.
specification.yes: Before 2029-01-01 00:00:00 America/New_York, a Waymo Driver passenger ride-hailing service must have opened to the general public, charged fares, and actually carried passengers without an in-vehicle safety driver on public-road trips with pickup and dropoff inside Boston municipal boundaries. Normal account/payment/age requirements and capacity limits are allowed; invite-only access, a launch waitlist, employee-only rides, free-only trials, mapping, safety-driver testing and announcements without service do not qualify. A limited neighborhood geofence or operating hours qualifies. A partner booking platform qualifies. A qualifying launch counts even if subsequently suspended. No airport access, citywide coverage, or operation through every snowstorm is required.

limitations: Implications are supplied by the agent and pinned to exact question versions.
Different information cutoffs can explain apparent incoherence; review before revising.

company_commitment_and_resources.interpretation: Preparation plus funded execution makes lack of intent/capital less concerning than permission.
unknowns: No verified Boston fleet size, depot commissioning date or binding launch date.

local_acceptance.interpretation: Local labor and operational concerns can delay service; accessibility support cuts the other way. A proposed ordinance is not an enacted ban.
unknowns: Current city coalition, final state preemption rules and conditions of any local approval.

public_access_and_launch_timing.interpretation: All-comer paid service is a stricter milestone than invited first riders. Recent staged rollouts warrant time for public access after permission.
unknowns: Boston launch sequence and whether fare collection/public access will be delayed.

state_permission.interpretation: The named enabling routes have not produced enactment in their retrieved histories. Study orders are a delay signal, not proof that every future route is closed.
unknowns: No verified leadership vote count, governor commitment or complete search of all authorization alternatives.

technical_and_weather_readiness.interpretation: Denver expansion is encouraging but does not establish Boston winter readiness. The event permits weather pauses and a limited geofence.
unknowns: No independent Boston-specific operating validation or winter service reliability data.

prior_record.qualification: Research status is an agent declaration; external research history is not independently observable.

forecasts.stopping_reason: Completed five substantive domains, distinguished staged access from the event, checked both enabling and competing proposals, and documented unresolved political and operational inputs. Further unstructured searches have low expected value relative to waiting for concrete policy changes.

triggers.description: Enacted Massachusetts authorization, a new enabling bill advancing, or a binding restrictive requirement.
Waymo announces Boston driverless passenger testing, public paid access, a firm schedule, or withdrawal.
Material Boston permit decision, major fleet safety restriction or operational evidence that changes winter readiness.
Reassess time remaining if a workable permission path is still absent at the start of 2028.
